entities.name: Luis González-Brabo y López de Arjona
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis González Bravo y López de Arjona was a Spanish politician, diplomat, intellectual, speaker, author, arts mentor, arts promoter and journalist. He graduated from law school and served twice as prime minister of Spain, in 1843–1844 and in 1868. During his first term, his government officially recognized Chile as an independent state.

entities.summary: Luis González Bravo y López de Arjona was a Spanish politician, diplomat, intellectual, speaker, author, arts mentor, arts promoter and journalist. He graduated from law school and served twice as prime minister of Spain, in 1843–1844 and in 1868. During his first term, his government officially recognized Chile as an independent state.
